title: Let the description wrap around the illustration and continue below
goal: Use float to wrap the text, and use clear to clear the wrapping of the next section.
summary: equipment card is an illustration and a description next to the illustration. The title of the next section should start from below the illustration.
tasks: Floats the .diagram to the left, leaving a 12px gap on the right.
Make .next-section clear the left float and start below the illustration.

example.note: floats to give way to the surrounding text. clear causes some subsequent block to start below the floated box.

hint: float and clear are written on different elements.
